title: Meridian Studio scenario
description: Meridian's BudgetOptimizer on the fit of a model.

model.description: The fitted model: models/<this>.yaml, fitted first.

window.description: The period whose spend is reallocated; default the whole fit.

budget.description: historical, an amount, or a change from historical like +10%. Ignored with target.

bounds.description: How far every channel may move from its historical spend, as fractions. Meridian's default 0.3 both ways.

channels.description: Channel → its own bounds, overriding bounds.

target.description: Flexible budget: spend until the target is met. budget is then ignored.

mroi.description: Marginal ROI below which no more is spent.

lower.description: At most this fraction below historical spend.

upper.description: At most this fraction above historical spend.
